classes.existing-c: state produced by previously reconstructed C in src/ (verified in earlier milestones)
classes.independent-model: original M25/M23 synthetic behavior; makes no retail claim
classes.fixture-external: declared synthetic input or an external service seam with no modeled effect
classes.inference-conflict: inferred meaning, an original-instruction prediction without observation, or a recorded disagreement
classes.unknown: not characterized; blocks the corresponding authentic claim
